automatic_finite_cutoff_exactness.reason: All nonlinearities are evaluated by finite projected operations inside A_N. There are no omitted modes relative to the selected source object.

D_N_or_commutator.definition: finite spectral/Dirac-style derivation encoded by left action and selected HYM transport; full Connes axioms not claimed

Delta_N.definition: finite projected Laplace/Dirac-square operator on the selected complement, transported from model to selected source
Delta_N.green_rule: G_s^sel = U G_s^model U^-1 on the complement

Green_N.definition: reduced inverse on Pi_N^perp complement in the finite source algebra

P_N.definition: projection from ambient symbolic/theta expressions to the selected finite qutrit-Weyl algebra A_N

exp_N.definition: finite algebra exponential of u_N by matrix functional calculus / Cayley-Hamilton finite polynomial in A_N

star_N.definition: a star_N b := P_N(a b); on represented A_N this is exact finite matrix multiplication
